column1: # The explained map: every difference between OneMail and an oracle must match a line here, or the run fails.
# Fields (tab separated): id, oracle (mimekit|python|go|*), message-name regex, class regex (whole), sub-class regex (search),
# detail regex (search), flags. Flag m = the rule only applies when another oracle agrees with OneMail on the same dimension
# (the two-of-three rule of docs/ambiguities.md). First matching line wins. The id names an entry of docs/ambiguities.md,
# NORM-* (a normalisation documented in tools/oracles/README.md) or LIMIT-* (a named limitation of an oracle).
